records.text: Anonymous Turning Point USA donors alleged that the purported video of Charlie Kirk naming Erika Kirk as his successor was entirely AI-generated and that Charlie never made the statement
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep FFQ9675oqRI)

appearances.snippet: Because it has been, according to our count, and I now have, I'm keeping the count here on our desk, 39 long days since we reported that donors who were present in Aspen assert that the audio which was shared by Turning Point USA of Charlie (Charlie Kirk) saying, I appoint my wife to run Turning Point USA, if something happens to me, she'll do a great job. was faked. This is what they are saying. I'm reporting that. They are saying that that was faked. It never happened. Charlie (Charlie Kirk) never said that.
donors are saying that the video is completely ai and they were present and Charlie (Charlie Kirk) never said that

verification.notes: The transcript attributes the allegation to anonymous Turning Point USA donors. Later public circulation of a succession video does not authenticate or disprove the anonymous claim, and no named donor, original recording, provenance record, or credible forensic analysis was located.

sources.title: Report on released Charlie Kirk succession video
sources.relevance: Confirms later circulation of a video but provides no named-donor evidence or credible forensic authentication resolving the anonymous AI allegation.

links.title: Donors Again Call Succession Video AI
